author: fhfuih
body:
If I understand it correctly, the main edit is the `_dit_module_names()`'s return clause. The rest `attrgetter` parts seems unnecessary. `attrgetter(attr_name)(obj)` is the same as `getattr(obj, attr_name)` unless you define one getter with one fixed name and use it multiple times. (But in your case, name is dynamic and for-looped)

Correct me if I am wrong, or I suggest removing the usage of `attrgetter` 🤔

author: david6666666
body: For flat names they're equivalent, but this PR is really about the dotted case: `getattr(pipeline, "language_model.model")` raises AttributeError and is treated as missing, while `attrgetter` walks the chain — that's why Bagel's nested DiT was silently dropped. The getter factory and `cache_summary` keep the same resolution so enable/summary stay consistent for multi-level names.

author: david6666666
body: Nice — this mirrors `vllm_omni/diffusion/offloader/module_collector.py`, which already resolves dotted `_dit_modules` paths via `attrgetter` (same try/except AttributeError, skip missing). If you ever want to dedupe, a tiny shared "resolve module path or None" helper would keep cache-dit and the offloader from drifting.
